name: Tatoe Sore ga Unmei de Atte mo
original_name: たとえそれが運命であっても
source:
Miyako, an alpha, has a happy relationship with her childhood friend and boyfriend Toto, a beta. But when Utsuro, an omega, transfers to their school, Miyako realizes that he's her fated mate.

[From [url=https://teatime.itch.io/even-if-this-is-fate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿尔法宫子与她儿时好友兼贝塔男友托托有着幸福的关系。但当Omega宇津郎转学到他们的学校时，宫子意识到他是她命中注定的伴侣。

[来自[url=https://teatime.itch.io/even-if-this-is-fate]Itch.io[/url]]
